captions.detailed: This object is a dual-actuation dropper seatpost featuring a long, black outer tube and a telescoping silver inner tube. At the top of the inner tube sits a black seat clamp mechanism with silver mounting bolts. A collar clamp ring is positioned at the top of the outer tube, which hosts two bright red side-lever actuators. The inner tube slides prismatically up and down inside the outer tube, while each red actuator lever pivots independently on its own revolute hinge at the collar.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a dual-actuation dropper seatpost. The assembly should feature a black cylindrical outer tube, a sliding silver inner tube with a seat clamp at the top, and a collar clamp containing two red side-lever actuators that pivot on revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube using a cylinder primitive, adding a larger concentric cylinder at its top to represent the collar clamp ring. Model the inner tube as a smaller cylinder and add a box-based seat clamp structure at its upper end. Form each red side lever using a combination of box primitives for the arm and handle, then define a prismatic joint between the inner and outer tubes, and two revolute joints connecting each side lever to the collar clamp.
